name: phase2c_paired_v1
description: Paired counterfactual training on Phase 2C branch data. Same models/protocol as Phase 2A (GRU) and Phase 2B (graph); see scripts/train_paired.py.
lambda_selection_rule: lowest val paired loss (val_branch.cf_total) among lambdas whose val state loss (val_state.total) is <= 1.05 x that of the lambda=0 'arms' control on the same fold; validation branch points of the training buildings only
